publicReleaseNotes:
**First-run setup keeps your saved time zone.** Reading your website and confirming setup preserve a valid saved zone. An invalid saved zone falls back to the browser's zone, or UTC if neither is valid. Page-settings saves also record the operator and the previous and new time zones in the audit log.

- **Incident lists load one page at a time.** Active and resolved incidents have separate Previous and Next controls, 50 incidents per page and totals for each list. Imports and backups still include complete incident update histories.
- **The subscriber directory reads the page you are viewing.** Its oldest-first order remains stable when subscribers share a join time. Component reads also avoid loading unrelated history, and reading components no longer starts pending notification work.
- **Website and status-feed reading handle malformed markup more reliably.** Website icon detection processes leading SVG comments without repeatedly revisiting them, and feed text removes nested markup before displaying it as plain text.
- **The build uses Vite 8.2.4.** The checkout keeps rer 0.2.108.

Upgrading from 1.11.15: back up data and your source changes first, update the checkout to `v1.11.16`, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `rer deploy` with the same environment and input file. The deploy applies two migrations in order: `0079_subscriber_directory_order.sql` adds the subscriber directory order index; `0080_incident_list_paging.sql` adds incident-list indexes and backfills lifecycle totals maintained by database triggers. The migrations retain existing subscriber and incident records and incident update history. Keep the backup before deployment and check your installation's workflows after updating. The checkout keeps rer 0.2.108. Earlier installations also follow the retained upgrade notes below, including keeping `INSTALLATION_KEY` with their private secrets.

SETUP-002.summary: First-run setup preserves a valid saved time zone and uses the browser zone or UTC only to recover an invalid saved zone.
SETUP-002.was: First-run setup filled observed website details and the browser time zone, replacing the saved page time zone when the owner confirmed setup.
SETUP-002.now: First-run setup and website confirmation preserve any valid saved time zone. Only an invalid saved zone adopts a valid browser time zone, or UTC when neither zone is valid; website reading still fills only observed page name, tagline, PNG mark, accent and navigation components.

migrations.buyerSteps: Back up data and owner source before deployment. After updating the checkout and installing frozen dependencies, rer deploy applies this migration after 0078 and before 0080. Adds the subscriber directory order index; existing subscriber records, consent and delivery history are retained. No new account or credential is required.

Keep the pre-upgrade data and source backup. The same rer deploy applies this migration after 0079 before starting the updated Worker. Adds incident-list seek indexes and backfills lifecycle totals maintained by database triggers; incident records and complete update history are retained. No new account or credential is required.
Apply the normal migrations to index due work and public history; existing records are retained.

agentUpdateInstructions: From v1.11.15: back up data and owner source first, update the checkout to v1.11.16, run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (the checkout keeps @runeditrun/rer 0.2.108) and rer deploy with the same environment and input file. The deploy applies 0079_subscriber_directory_order.sql and then 0080_incident_list_paging.sql before starting the updated Worker. These add directory and incident-list indexes and backfill lifecycle totals maintained by database triggers. Existing subscriber records, incident records and complete update history are retained; keep the pre-upgrade backup and exercise the installation's affected workflows after deployment. Earlier installations first honor the retained release-history records through 1.11.15, including INSTALLATION_KEY provisioning and backup custody. Preserve all published release records, immutable contract snapshots and applied migration history. Preserve the optional LAMP_PAGE_HOST_ROUTE_ZONE and LAMP_PAGE_HOST_TARGET settings (set together, never with LAMP_HOSTING=workers-dev) and every deploy writing page_settings.hostname equal to LAMP_PAGE_HOST. Run the existing verifier and release validator before adopting.
